name: flexsim-mcp
description: Unofficial. Run Autodesk FlexSim models from Claude without a window: what-if runs, parameters, performance measures, tables and FlexScript.
long_description: Unofficial community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Autodesk. Requires your own licensed FlexSim install. Drives FlexSim through its command line (/maintenance nogui_disablemsg_runscript). Runs are queued one at a time and time-limited. The server never saves model files, but scripts you pass run with full FlexScript access.

tools.name: flexsim_check_installation

flexsim_exe.title: FlexSim executable
flexsim_exe.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the newest installed FlexSim. Set this only to choose a specific version or a custom install location.

timeout_seconds.title: Default run timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: FlexSim is stopped if a run takes longer than this. Each call can override it.
